summary: Flat kerb at the south end, homes 15-21 m away on the same side.
reasons: Few cars park on this side

best_section.where: south end of the east kerb on Taringa Parade, by the school-zone marking

drivers.seclusion: Bush across the road, but houses and a row of homes sit 15-21 m away on the van's own side.
drivers.access_and_room: Plain kerb on a sealed through road; a few cars park along the east edge so there is room to pull in.
drivers.traffic: Through road with moving traffic; a school-zone marking at the start.
drivers.convention: Mostly residential frontage with only occasional kerbside cars; no sign a van would blend in.

flags: Steep south to north: mean 6.3%, max 11.6% over the whole stretch, but under 3% at 0-15 m
sun_shade: Open kerb; trees on the east side give some morning shade, bush to the west.
